anthropic/claude-opus-5-5.feedback: After moves every targeted fact and keeps the ones Before held. Before failed separate because #12's menu was folded into the batch-summary message (its first line was gate=gatekeep-pr/batch-summary, not own-merge); After gives each PR its own gate=gatekeep-pr/own-merge recommended=1 message (A2/A4, B2/B4) with no re-render. Before failed retirement because the `gauntlet: retired #12` marker was printed as the first line of the message that then ran the steps (and even carried the queue acknowledgement beneath it), so the PR appeared retired before its steps finished; After runs the steps (A6/A8, B6) and emits the retired marker afterward (A7/A9, B7/B8), then one `gauntlet: done retired` message that in B names #15's unpicked cleanup and announce with their exact commands. Before failed standing by appending `| evidence: ci | blockers: 0` to the copied sentence; After copies both sentences verbatim with no extra fields. shared, once and queue hold in both: After keeps publish docs as individual row 4 on #12, out of #12's row 1 and in #15's row 1 only, runs it once at the picked PR with the roster recording that fact, and prints the exact `Queued until all picks are collected` acknowledgement before any roster-order execution in the parent. No wording regressions to fix; if anything, keep the explicit 'parent roster records that shared publish docs has run' sentence, since that is what carries the once fact across rounds.

github-copilot/gpt-6.1-sol.feedback: Before refused the whole replay with a stuck marker, so it kept only the standing fact; After delivers every fact: one own-merge menu per PR in its own message, shared publish as an individual row 4 on #12 but inside row 1 only on #15, the exact 'Queued until all picks are collected' acknowledgement before any execution, roster-order execution in the parent, per-PR 'gauntlet: retired #N' markers, a single 'gauntlet: done retired' closing that names #15's unpicked cleanup and announce with commands in B, a once-only publish that later menus omit, and the standing sentences copied verbatim without verdict fields. Two things to tighten so the facts stay robust: After rewrites the snapshot's cleanup commands as `git -C /tmp/widgets worktree remove ...` rather than the stipulated `git worktree remove /tmp/widgets-pr-12`, and quotes the announce args as `'#12'`; since the Entry asks for exact commands, the wording should instruct the parent to reproduce the supplied command strings verbatim. It also appends ' - merged' to the retired markers and introduces `H12`/`H15` placeholders the snapshot never supplied; prefer the bare `gauntlet: retired #12` marker and omit invented head identifiers so a strict reader cannot dispute the marker or the settlement lines.
